notes:
Primary focus: low-latency streaming agent assist for live voice & chat agents.
- Want inline suggestions and tool-call actions (one-click ticket update, Cx tool API) streamed as agent types.

- Preference for quantized model variants for cost; fallback flow to cheaper policy when Dedicated saturated.
- "We need deterministic latency—cannot have suggestion delays >200ms or agents lose trust" (Head of Ops).
- Compliance: must keep transcripts in-region (US-East) and support 7y retention controls for regulated customers.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize for batching and KV caching suggestions across frequent intents to save token spend.
